note: Acceptance scenarios (Anthropic skill-creator convention; no standard runner yet).

evals.name: well-formed-page-passes
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page with full provenance frontmatter, layered input/output split, and a parse_status on every value-bearing artifact.

evals.name: value-without-source-pointer-fails
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page carrying a numeric value but no sources: pointer in frontmatter.

evals.name: fail-closed-citation
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page whose derived constant cites a source page whose frontmatter is missing or mismatched.
expect: fails closed (refuses) rather than shipping an unprovable value

evals.name: degenerate-identity-fails
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page with a row whose identity tuple has a blank field.
expect: would otherwise let two distinct rows collapse and silently drop one

evals.name: ace-retrieval-chunk-metadata-required
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on an ACE retrieval chunk missing citation_id, edition, or lifecycle_state metadata.
expect: blocks the page because #61 retrieval chunks require closed metadata
names the missing metadata fields instead of treating the chunk as verified

evals.name: ace-wave1-row-shape-required
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on an ACE wave-1 text/config row missing route_target or extraction_yield.
expect: blocks the row because wave-1 rows require candidate_id, candidate_class, route_target, logical_target_store, parse_status, visibility, public_clearance, signals, extraction_estimate, and extraction_yield

evals.name: ace-wave1-public-token-abstraction-required
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a public-routed ACE wave-1 row with literal private lookup material.
expect: allows only abstract public tokens and private provenance bundle references
